services.name: CrossFit
services.desc: Since 2007, CFSBK has been running world-class CrossFit group classes built around our posted workout of the day. Expect to be challenged by the workouts, educated by our coaches, and supported by your fellow athletes. We offer 56 classes per week across both locations. Prior to joining group classes, we require completion of our Foundations program. We’ll teach you all the primary movements you need to be successful and safe in group class, plus a better understanding of the CrossFit methodology.
